_comment: Shelter data for South 24 Parganas / Sagar Island.
STATUS: NO VERIFIED SHELTER LOCATIONS OR CAPACITIES AVAILABLE.
This file intentionally contains an empty shelter list. It is a real
result, not a placeholder to be filled in later with invented numbers.
What was checked, and what it yielded:
1. OSM amenity=shelter over the study bbox (21.30,87.80,22.60,89.20):
21 elements. Their shelter_type values are gazebo (4),
public_transport (3), sun_shelter (1) and unset (13) - i.e. bus
shelters and roadside gazebos, NOT cyclone shelters. None carry a
capacity tag. Usable as cyclone shelters: 0.
2. West Bengal Disaster Management & Civil Defence Department,
official Cyclone Shelters page
http://www.wbdmd.gov.in/Pages/Cyclone_Shelters.aspx
Confirms a real, citable figure: 15 Multipurpose Cyclone Shelters
(MPCS) were built in South 24 Parganas under the PMNRF scheme,
with 12 handed over to the District Magistrate by the page's last
update. It also records 150 proposed MPCS across the three coastal
districts under NCRMP. BUT the page publishes only scheme-level
counts, funding and construction history - it lists no individual
shelter names, coordinates, or capacities, and links to the HSCL
and EPLL centre lists are not retrievable from it.
WHY THIS IS EMPTY RATHER THAN POPULATED:
Rules.md requires that every historical number trace to a real, named
source, and that an estimate is never presented as an observation.
Inventing 15 shelter locations or capacity figures would violate that
directly, and would put fabricated evacuation assignments - the one
output in this system that could get someone hurt - into a demo shown
to emergency-management judges.
WHAT THE ALLOCATION MODULE DOES INSTEAD:
It runs the real linear program against explicitly-labelled DEMO
capacities so the algorithm is demonstrable, and every such number is
marked is_demo_data: true in the output, with the official count of 15
MPCS carried through as the scale reference. See
backend/simulation/shelters.py for the full provenance and the exact
conditions under which a real list may replace this one.

official_reference.source: West Bengal Disaster Management & Civil Defence Department, Cyclone Shelters page
official_reference.note: Scheme-level count only. No per-shelter names, coordinates or capacities are published on this page.

osm_check.note: gazebos, bus shelters and one sun shelter; none carry a capacity tag
